dossier.family_title: QQQ/SPY weekly relative-breadth rotation on the QQEW/QQQ and RSP/SPY equal-weight/cap-weight spread trend
dossier.falsifiable_hypothesis: HYPOTHESIS (not evidence). WHO is forced/late: (a) passive cap-weighted indexation and benchmark-hugging active money are mechanically forced to concentrate further into already-large names during concentration regimes, because index construction buys winners; (b) allocation decisions that de-concentrate move on institutional rebalancing calendars (quarterly/committee cycles), so broadening flow arrives in persistent multi-week waves after the concentration state is already visible in the equal-weight/cap-weight spread. Observable: the equal-weight-vs-cap-weight relative total-return trend inside the SAME underlying universe (QQEW/QQQ inside the Nasdaq-100; RSP/SPY inside the S&P 500) is a direct, tradeable measurement of that dispersion state — a composition/second-moment observable, not the cross-sectional price ranking that died as STOCKS-FREE-V2 A4_XSEC_ETF_RELATIVE_MOMENTUM. Declared mechanism: weeks in which the combined breadth spread is RISING are persistent broadening regimes in which participation broadens past the mega-caps and the cap-weighted Nasdaq-100 proxy compounds the second wave, while weeks of falling combined breadth are concentration regimes whose resolution lands against the most top-heavy leg; therefore a weekly binary long-only rotation 100% QQQ / 100% SPY conditioned on the 13-week breadth trend earns a net excess over both buy-and-holds, a static 50/50, and the risk-matched occupancy benchmark, at weekly-rebalance ETF band costs with no leverage and no short. Why any effect could persist: breadth-state autocorrelation inherited from slow allocation flows gives the weekly decision a multi-week information horizon that a zero-leverage long-only book can harvest at low turnover. When it must fail: when the EW/CW spread's weekly co-movement with plain QQQ/SPY relative momentum exceeds the ancestry bar (then it is momentum in new words — pre-score veto R0); when one leg's beta dominates occupancy (then the rule collapses to buy-and-hold — the ancestor's exact death, frozen as kill R2); at concentration extremes where rebalance-driven mean reversion flips the trend sign violently; and wherever the two sub-spreads disagree about which leg benefits, because NDX-internal breadth and S&P-internal breadth are not the same factor (frozen kill R6).

anchor_arm.instruments: traded legs QQQ, SPY (only these are ever held); state inputs QQEW, RSP (never traded, state-only)
anchor_arm.data_series: EODHD US-ETF EOD daily ADJUSTED close (split + dividend adjusted, total-return basis) for all four instruments, one frozen snapshot pinned at the future cycle's S-stage. PIT rule: session D's adjusted close is treated as available at D's 16:00 ET close (close-of-day decision, next-open execution); no intraday data; the snapshot is never re-pulled mid-cycle (P-12: the frozen representation binds).
anchor_arm.raw_vs_adjusted_ruling: ONE frozen convention: the STATE is computed on the dividend-adjusted series so the spread measures relative TOTAL RETURN between weighting schemes and carries no deterministic dividend-yield wedge (EW indices yield slightly more than CW; on split-only prices this embeds a constant negative drift into every lookback change). The traded legs use the same adjusted series, so state and book are one consistent representation. The split-only-price state variant is NOT tested in-cycle and is declared a representation limitation, not a sensitivity arm.
anchor_arm.state_formula: s_t = 0.5 * ( ln(P_qqew_t / P_qqq_t) + ln(P_rsp_t / P_spy_t) ), sampled weekly at t = last session of each ISO week. m_t(L) = s_t - s_(t-L). z_t = m_t(L) / stdev({m_(t-i)(L) : i = 0..103}), trailing 104 weekly observations, sample stdev (ddof=1).
anchor_arm.lookbacks_one_primary_two_arms: PRIMARY FROZEN: L = 13 weeks, z-window 104 weeks. Declared sensitivity arms (exactly two, arms of the same family, not a grid): ARM-FAST-L4 (L = 4 weeks) and ARM-SLOW-L52 (L = 52 weeks), both z-window 104, everything else identical. Three trial identities if all scored.
anchor_arm.weekly_decision_clock: Decision session D_t = last regular NYSE/Nasdaq common trading session of the ISO week (America/New_York; NYSE holiday calendar; holiday-shortened weeks use that week's final regular session). Decision computed from closes through D_t inclusive. Execution: at the OPEN of the first subsequent regular session E_t (next-session executable fill, typically Monday open); if E_t is a holiday, first session after. Holding window [E_t open, E_(t+1) open).
anchor_arm.rotate_forceflat_rule: z_t >= 0 -> hold QQQ for the coming week; z_t < 0 -> hold SPY. Declared sign is a HYPOTHESIS. Exactly one leg held at all times: 100% weight, long-only, no leverage, no short, gross cap 1.0 by construction. A rotation executes only when the rule flips legs (turnover <= 1 swap/week); cost charged EXACTLY ONCE per fill on the swapped notional under the frozen stocks/ETF band-cost schedule. Force-flat at every fold boundary.
anchor_arm.missing_data_failclosed: If any of the four adjusted closes is absent at D_t, or z_t is undefined (insufficient warmup), the decision is SKIPPED and the book holds its prior leg; every skip recorded with a reason code; never inferred.
anchor_arm.window_and_warmup: Weekly series starts 2006-04-21 (asserted QQEW inception + buffer — P0 must evidence this). First eligible decision = first week with 104 + L complete weekly observations. Three chronological folds with boundaries frozen at the future cycle's S-stage before any scored return exists.
anchor_arm.total_return_accounting: All legs marked on dividend-adjusted closes (dividends implicitly reinvested); no financing (unlevered long); cost-once per fill; both gross and net books reported; margin-to-fail recorded per gate (P-2); per-period weekly return series persisted for DSR/PBO (P-11).

structural_neighbour_arm.construction: LEVEL form of the same state, distinct from the trend form: zLvl_t = (s_t - mean(s over trailing 104 weeks)) / stdev(s over trailing 104 weeks); rule zLvl_t >= 0 -> hold QQQ else hold SPY; identical clock, legs, costs, folds, accounting, missing-data rule. It conditions on WHERE breadth IS (regime level) rather than WHERE IT IS GOING (13-week change) — a different construction of the same family information, not a lookback variant.
structural_neighbour_arm.non_degeneracy_note: If the neighbour were the sign-inverted trend it would be CTL-INV — same family, two arms, not two families. The LEVEL form is declared precisely to avoid that degeneracy.
structural_neighbour_arm.preregistered_identifiability_check: At D2, pooled |rho| between the ARM-LEVEL state series and the ANCHOR state series on the frozen decision grid must be <= 0.98; above it the neighbour is the same book and dies as SELF-SUBSUMED (P-20 books-distinct doctrine), family continues anchor-only. None of this uses candidate returns.

mandatory_inverted_and_delayed_controls.CTL-INV: Identical ANCHOR-TREND-L13 construction with the rule sign flipped: z_t >= 0 -> SPY, z_t < 0 -> QQQ. Same clock/costs/folds/accounting. Preregistered interpretation: CTL-INV out-earning the anchor means the declared mechanism sign is wrong (V11/V12 falsification-cluster class); the inversion is recorded, never pursued as rescue.
mandatory_inverted_and_delayed_controls.CTL-DELAY-1W: Identical ANCHOR-TREND-L13 but the decision at D_t uses the state computed through D_(t-1) (state series shifted one weekly decision back). Preregistered interpretation, family-specific and honest: this family DECLARES a multi-week information horizon, so delayed-reproduces-anchor alone is NOT a mechanism kill (Q-11: a permutation that does not move a slow signal is an invalid null, and slowness is part of the mechanism claim). CTL-DELAY-1W is evaluated as (a) leak/PIT detector: any outcome where the delayed control materially OUT-EARNS the anchor converts to a lookahead audit before anything else; (b) horizon estimator under the combination rule: if all four books {fresh, delayed} x {normal, inverted} are mutually indistinguishable on the frozen grid, the state is pure slow drift with no sign-specific weekly content — family dead by K6.

falsification_rule.K6_combination_rule_for_slow_drift: All four books {fresh, delayed} x {normal, inverted} mutually indistinguishable (pairwise net-expectancy differences within fold noise, exact test frozen at S) -> the state is pure slow drift, no sign-specific weekly content -> REJECT.
falsification_rule.house_stage_A_gates_on_survivors: Any arm surviving R0-R6 still faces the frozen stocks Stage-A gates: fold-positive-share <= 50%, largest-fold concentration of positive PnL <= 50%, MDD ceiling 15%, stress tier 2.0 net, break-even cost margin, drop-one-fold sign stability, leg-exclusion (LOPO) robustness; every gate reported with margin-to-fail (P-2) and persisted per-period series (P-11).

required_controls.spec: QQQ buy-and-hold over the identical window, folds, cost and accounting convention; no rotation.
Static 50/50 QQQ/SPY on the SAME weekly clock with weekly rebalancing charged at the same band costs — the honest turnover-matched passive.

Static QQQ/SPY mix whose QQQ weight equals the anchor's historical state occupancy — the fraction of decisions with z_t >= 0, computed from the frozen STATE series only (outcome-blind, uses no returns), set once at window start and left to drift. The beta-matched passive benchmark.
Relative-momentum-only: hold QQQ if trailing 13-week total return(QQQ) > total return(SPY) else SPY; same clock/costs/folds. THE named kill candidate (R3).
Volatility-only: hold QQQ if trailing 21-session realized vol(QQQ) < realized vol(SPY) else SPY; same clock/costs. Declared lower-vol-preference direction, outcome-blind.
Deterministic week-parity alternation QQQ/SPY by ISO-week parity; same turnover class, zero information (R4).
One-week delayed breadth anchor (deliverable 4; leak detector + combination rule K6).
State from ln(QQEW/QQQ) alone, same L=13, z104, same rule (R6).

expected_failure_modes: QQQ-bull credit theft — the most likely death: QQQ outperformed SPY across most of the testable window (2006-2026 mega-cap tech bull). Any rule with majority-QQQ occupancy inherits that beta; the family must earn its verdict on R2 (risk-matched/occupancy benchmark) and R3 (momentum reduction), never on raw PnL. Expected terminal: anchor ~ C-BH-QQQ -> R2 fires.

Breadth-is-momentum reduction: ln(EW/CW) trends and QQQ/SPY momentum are both driven by mega-cap concentration; the weekly correlation plausibly exceeds the 0.20 bar -> pre-score D2 veto (the fate of 10/10 NG-generation proposals at this bar).

Incoherent combination: under the concentration story the two sub-spreads pull in OPPOSITE directions for the QQQ-vs-SPY choice (NDX-internal broadening can be bearish for pure mega-cap momentum QQQ while S&P-internal broadening favors diversification), so the averaged state may be a muddy average of two opposite signals — R6 single-source controls expose this.

Fold concentration: the breadth-crash / QQQ-crash relationship is dominated by 2020 and 2022 events; a 3-fold chronological split likely shows the mechanism in one fold -> fold-positive-share and concentration gates fire.

Slow-state ambiguity: because the family declares a multi-week horizon, the delay control cannot function as a mechanism-specificity test (declared in advance, Q-11); if all four {fresh, delayed} x {normal, inverted} books are indistinguishable the state is pure slow drift -> K6. This subtle kill would be missed without the preregistered combination rule.

ETF-pair artifacts: the state measures traded ETF pairs — expense ratios (~0.20-0.40%, differing by pair) embedded in the ratio, quarterly EW reconstitutions, creation/flow microstructure — not theoretical indices; rebalance-calendar effects could manufacture a calendar artifact -> C-CLOCK-ONLY and S6 guard this.

Short window: the 2006-04 start truncates history — no 2000-2002 concentration unwind and the warmup eats into 2008; the oldest fold is thin on concentration regimes. At program scale (N ~ 260 observed trials) even a clean pass has a near-zero DSR (V14 lesson).

Sign fragility: both directions of the breadth sign are economically arguable (broadening-bullish vs concentration-momentum-bullish); the declared sign is a coin-flip hypothesis — if CTL-INV wins, the family dies by R5 and the inversion is recorded, never rescued.
Cost triviality is not a free pass: ~0.5-1 swap/week at ETF band costs looks cheap, but the preregistered cost ladder frozen at S binds regardless of realized cheapness (VOL-NG1 P-21 lesson).
